A.title: Reset your security token
A.markdown:
# Reset your security token
## Overview
Use this guide if your security token has expired or was compromised.
## Steps
1. Go to **Settings** → **Global Reset**.
2. Choose *Confirm reset*.
## Troubleshooting
If the option is missing, contact support.

B.title: Download an invoice
B.markdown:
# Download an invoice
## Overview
Use this guide to download a copy of any past invoice.
## Steps
1. Go to **Billing** → **Invoices** → **Download**.
2. Choose *PDF format*.
## Troubleshooting
If no invoices appear, check your billing period filter.

C.title: Enable email notifications
C.markdown:
# Enable email notifications
## Overview
Use this guide to turn on email alerts for account activity.
## Steps
1. Go to **Settings** → **Notifications** → **Email**.
2. Choose *Enable*.
## Troubleshooting
Check your spam folder if emails don't arrive.

D.title: Update your profile photo
D.markdown:
# Update your profile photo
## Overview
Use this guide to change the photo shown on your profile.
## Steps
1. Go to **Profile** → **Edit** → **Photo**.
2. Choose *Upload new image*.
## Troubleshooting
Images must be under 5MB.

E.title: How to process a partial refund
E.markdown:
# How to process a partial refund
## Overview
Use this procedure when a customer should get back part of a payment, for example a duplicate charge or an overcharge on one invoice.
## Steps
1. Open the customer record and go to **Billing** → **Payments**.
2. Select the charge that needs a partial refund and choose *Refund*.
3. Enter the partial refund amount (the duplicate or overcharged portion only) and a refund reason.
4. Confirm the partial refund. The amount returns to the original payment method in 5-10 business days.
## Troubleshooting
If the Refund option is greyed out, the charge has not settled yet - wait 24 hours.

F.title: How to cancel a subscription
F.markdown:
# How to cancel a subscription
## Overview
Use this procedure when a customer wants to stop their subscription plan and not be billed again.
## Steps
1. Go to **Billing** → **Subscriptions**.
2. Select the active plan and choose *Cancel subscription*.
3. Pick whether the cancellation takes effect immediately or at the end of the current billing period.
4. Confirm the cancellation. The customer receives a cancellation email.
## Troubleshooting
Cancelling does not refund past charges; use the refund procedures for that.

G.title: How to update a billing address
G.markdown:
# How to update a billing address
## Overview
Use this procedure when a customer needs to change the billing address printed on invoices and used for tax.
## Steps
1. Go to **Billing** → **Payment Details**.
2. Choose *Edit billing address*.
3. Enter the new street address, city, postal code and country, then save.
4. Future invoices use the new billing address; past invoices are unchanged.
## Troubleshooting
Tax is recalculated from the new address on the next invoice.

H.title: How to issue a full refund
H.markdown:
# How to issue a full refund
## Overview
Use this procedure when a customer should get the entire payment back, for example an unused annual plan cancelled within the refund window.
## Steps
1. Open the customer record and go to **Billing** → **Payments**.
2. Select the payment and choose *Refund*.
3. Choose *Full refund* so the entire amount is returned, and enter a refund reason.
4. Confirm. The full amount returns to the original payment method in 5-10 business days.
## Troubleshooting
Full refunds are only available within 30 days of payment.
